$comment: Example Antigravity MCP configuration for Frontier Engineer. To enable an integration, set disabled to false and export the required environment variables in your operating system environment before launching Antigravity.

github.description: Provides secure, read-only-by-default access to GitHub remote repository operations, issue tracking, and pull request inspection using GitHub's official MCP server.

requiredEnvironmentVariables.GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN: GitHub personal access token with scoped repository read permissions.
requiredEnvironmentVariables.GITHUB_READ_ONLY: Enforces server-side read-only mode, disabling all write actions (default: true).

context7.description: Enables fast, authoritative technical documentation lookup, library version resolution, and code snippet retrieval from Context7.

requiredEnvironmentVariables.CONTEXT7_API_KEY: Optional API key providing elevated rate limits for Context7 documentation queries.

playwright.description: Enables browser automation, interactive DOM inspection, accessibility tree validation, and screenshot capture for UI verification using official @playwright/mcp.

requiredEnvironmentVariables.PLAYWRIGHT_HEADLESS: Controls headless execution mode (default: true via CLI flag).
requiredEnvironmentVariables.PLAYWRIGHT_ISOLATED: Enforces in-memory isolated profile without persistent cookies or local storage (default: true via CLI flag).

sentry.description: Provides access to Sentry error monitoring, stack trace inspection, crash reports, and issue triage using official @sentry/mcp-server.

requiredEnvironmentVariables.SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN: Sentry User Auth Token with project read permissions (org:read, project:read, event:read).

database.description: Enables schema inspection, index analysis, execution plan generation, and safe read-only queries for PostgreSQL using @microsoft/postgres-mcp.

requiredEnvironmentVariables.POSTGRES_MCP_CONNECTION_STRING: PostgreSQL connection string with read-only credentials (e.g., postgresql://frontier_readonly:pass@host:5432/dbname).
